name: Agentic CI/CD
outcome: Integrate a bounded coding-agent task into a reproducible CI workflow with independent release gates.
description: Use CI to run an isolated agent task or review against a supplied scientific project. Retain human approval, least privilege and deterministic tests; no autonomous production deployment.
learn: Design a restricted noninteractive agent job
Validate artifacts with deterministic tests and explicit approval gates
Protect credentials and preserve an auditable execution record
tools: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (choose one)
GitHub Actions or local CI runner
prior: Basic CI/CD, Git, YAML and shell scripting
practice: Add a review-only or patch-producing agent job to a disposable scientific repository using a local runner or approved CI sandbox.
acceptance: The job cannot merge or deploy; failing checks prevent acceptance; credentials remain out of logs; the recorded artifact can be independently reviewed.
external: Basic CI/CD, Git, YAML and shell scripting
moduleDescriptions: Distinguish trusted jobs, untrusted inputs and release permissions.
Configure a restricted job with timeouts and a narrow output artifact.
Run tests and stop the workflow on failure; require human merge approval.
Record versions, logs and artifacts without exposing secrets.
prerequisiteRationale: S05 supplies controlled change and approval semantics. Prior CI fundamentals remain external prerequisites.
